snippet.description:
Preparing Sociology Optional Paper 2? Don’t assume that a dynamic paper means you need to study every current affair in detail.

In this video, understand an important pro tip for Sociology Paper 2 preparation—why you should first analyse Previous Year Questions (PYQs) to understand the actual relevance of current affairs, instead of spending hours collecting and reading multiple PDFs.

Learn how to make your Sociology Optional preparation more focused and efficient by prioritising what UPSC actually asks.
